subject: Proposed MAP: Onboarding pathway and stepped private-offer discounts (Azure)
messages:
From: Sarah Jenkins <sarah.jenkins@olivetech.com>
To: mina_haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.inference>
Date: 2027-03-19T08:14:00Z
Subject: Re: Initial interest — evaluation and POA

Thanks Mina — we reviewed Redwood's hosted demo and would like to formalize an evaluation timeline. Key asks from our side:
- Short POC (3 weeks) focused on latency and cost with our internal prompt set
- Visibility into token-level billing (for audit)
- Marketplace procurement path — prefer Private Offer on Azure, but we may want a GCP fallback

Can you send a short mutual action plan (MAP) that ties milestones to pricing steps and marketplace milestones so procurement can map approvals?

Regards,
Sarah
Sarah Jenkins
Director, Platform Engineering, OliveTech
[attachment: olivetech-eval-requirements.pdf (pdf)]
From: mina_haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.inference>
To: Sarah Jenkins <sarah.jenkins@olivetech.com>
Cc: karthik_iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.inference>, marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference>
Date: 2027-03-19T10:05:00Z
Subject: Re: Proposed MAP: Onboarding pathway and stepped private-offer discounts (Azure)

Hi Sarah — great to hear. Attached is a concise MAP outline and a first-pass private-offer term sheet for Azure. High-level proposal (summary):

1) Milestone A — POC complete (3 weeks):
   - Deliverable: integration + perf report (latency histogram + token breakdown)
   - Commercial: evaluation credits to offset POC tokens (up to $10k) + standard hosted pricing

2) Milestone B — Pilot/scale (3 months):
   - Deliverable: pilot acceptance criteria met, sample production traffic
   - Commercial: negotiated temporary step discount (20%) applied via Azure Private Offer for pilot months

3) Milestone C — Commit (12-month):
   - Deliverable: signed private-offer and committed monthly spend
   - Commercial: staged tiered discount ladder (40% -> 55% at commit thresholds) reflected in private-offer terms; one-time onboarding credits and a ramp credit schedule

Notes: we can include an explicit fallback clause that maps the same MAP milestones to a GCP private offer if you elect to run in that region later. I put a short timeline and suggested owner column in the attached MAP draft (20270319-MAP-draft.xlsx).

Next steps: if this looks directionally right, Karthis and Marissa will run a quick sizing/cost-run and Rafael can prepare an Azure private-offer term sheet for procurement to review.

Cheers,
Mina Haddad
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
[attachment: 20270319-MAP-draft.xlsx (xlsx)]
From: karthik_iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.inference>
To: mina_haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.inference>, marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference>, rafael_mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.inference>
Cc: ben_carter <ben.carter@redwood.inference>
Date: 2027-03-20T09:30:00Z
Subject: Re: Proposed MAP: onboarding pathway and stepped private-offer discounts (Sizing + cost assumptions)

All — doing a quick pass on the numbers Sarah sent. I ran a crude model for two pilot profiles:

- Pilot A (low throughput): 200k tokens/day average, 95th pct seq len 512
- Pilot B (mixed load): bursty 1.2M tokens/day, avg seq len 256

Suggested MAP-linked commercial levers we can offer in the Azure private-offer term sheet:
- POC credits: 10k USD applied as invoice credit after Milestone A acceptance
- Pilot step discount: 20% off list for the 3-month pilot as a temporary marketplace private-offer rate (billing passed-through via Azure)
- Commit ladder:
   * Commit T1: 250k USD/month -> 40% off list for first 6 months
   * Commit T2: 500k USD/month -> 50% off list after T1 sustained for 90 days
   * Commit T3: 1,000k USD/month -> 55% off list plus priority capacity pool (Dedicated)

Operational controls: token-level invoices, monthly usage dashboards (Console), automated fallbacks to lower-cost model variant if budget cap hit (configurable).

I'll drop a draft term-sheet (azure-private-offer-term-sheet.docx) by EOD for Rafael and Legal to review. If procurement needs specific Azure PO fields (offer id, plan id), Rafael will capture those in the Doc.

-Karthik
Staff Solutions Architect | Redwood Inference
[attachment: azure-private-offer-term-sheet.docx (docx)]
From: Sarah Jenkins <sarah.jenkins@olivetech.com>
To: mina_haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.inference>
Cc: procurement@olivetech.com
Date: 2027-03-21T14:02:00Z
Subject: Re: Proposed MAP: Onboarding pathway and stepped private-offer discounts (Azure)

Thanks — MAP looks sensible. Procurement and I reviewed the draft and have a handful of redlines focused on:
- Clarity on how the 20% pilot discount surfaces on Azure billing (we need invoice examples)
- Data retention and audit log retention (required 3 years)
- Termination and early-exit credits for pilot-to-commit transition

I've attached our redlined SOW and a short procurement checklist. Can Legal and Rafael take the lead?

-Sarah
[attachment: OliveTech-SOW-redlines.pdf (pdf)]
